name: matrix-01
title: Fushimi Inari, the tunnel
text: The thousand gates of Fushimi Inari, receding uphill. The one warm thing in the frame is vermilion, repeated until it becomes a corridor.

name: matrix-02
title: Kinkaku-ji, on the pond
text: The golden pavilion and its reflection: two storeys of light over a black pond, a pine leaning in from the left.

name: matrix-03
title: Kiyomizu, the stage
text: The wooden stage of Kiyomizu-dera on its lattice of pillars, the hillside falling away below, the city as a spill of small lights.

name: matrix-04
title: Arashiyama, the bamboo
text: The bamboo grove at Arashiyama: culms taller than the frame, the light coming down between them in bars.

name: matrix-05
title: Gion, the lantern lane
text: A machiya street in Gion after dark: lattice fronts, tiled eaves, and a row of paper lanterns doing the work of the moon.

name: matrix-06
title: Togetsukyō, the moon bridge
text: The long bridge at Arashiyama over the Katsura, the hills behind it, and the moon it is named for.

name: matrix-07
title: Tō-ji, five storeys
text: The five-storey pagoda of Tō-ji, the tallest wooden tower in the country, drawn as five roofs and a spire against the moon.

name: matrix-08
title: The Philosopher's Path
text: The canal walk in blossom season: cherry trees on both banks, petals in the water, a stone path that only goes one way.

name: matrix-09
title: Ryōan-ji, the fifteen stones
text: The rock garden: raked gravel drawn as rows of glyphs, the stones as silences in it. You cannot see all fifteen from any one place, and you cannot here either.

name: matrix-10
title: Yasaka, the pagoda street
text: Hōkan-ji's pagoda at the top of the sloping street, the shop lanterns coming on, dusk doing the rest.

name: matrix-11
title: Shibuya, the crossing
text: The scramble from above: five screens, a thousand heads, every one of them a glyph for the two seconds the light is green.

name: matrix-12
title: Tokyo Tower, lit
text: The tower over Shiba, orange by night, the office blocks around it holding still while the rain moves.

name: matrix-13
title: Skytree, over the Sumida
text: The tallest thing in the city as a needle of light, the river taking a copy of it and breaking it up.

name: matrix-14
title: Omoide Yokochō
text: The yakitori alley behind Shinjuku station: six feet wide, lanterns overhead, every stall a lit window with smoke where the rain should be.

name: matrix-15
title: Rainbow Bridge
text: The suspension bridge across the bay from Odaiba, its cables as a lattice of glyphs, the bay black under it.

name: matrix-16
title: Akihabara, the signs
text: Electric Town: a wall of signage seven storeys high, each sign a block of glyphs at its own brightness.

name: matrix-17
title: Kaminarimon, the lantern
text: The thunder gate at Asakusa: one giant lantern, red, under a roof wide enough to hide the street behind it.

name: matrix-18
title: Shinkansen, the platform
text: The nose of the train at the platform, the doors lit, the departure board as a grid of glyphs that only says the time.

name: matrix-19
title: Tokyo Station, the facade
text: The Marunouchi side: two domes, three storeys of brick drawn as lit arches, the plaza empty for once.

name: matrix-20
title: Sumida, fireworks
text: The river festival: one burst over the skyline, the whole city looking up, the water taking the copy.

name: matrix-21
title: Nijō, the moat gate
text: The castle's karamon gate across still water, its ridge gilded, the banks in blossom on both sides.

name: matrix-22
title: Hakata, the yatai row
text: A line of yatai stalls by the canal, steam over each counter, Fukuoka Tower's diamond skin catching the little light there is.

name: matrix-23
title: Noboribetsu, Jigokudani
text: Hell Valley by night: steam standing over sulphur ground, an oni's red eyes on the ridge above the onsen roofs, snow keeping everything else quiet.
